faq.q: What is Feria San Bernabe 2032 and when does it take place?
faq.a: Feria San Bernabe is Marbella's main summer fair, held annually in early June. In 2032 the dates are 2–8 June. It features a fairground with rides, live music, casetas (tents), and traditional Andalusian food and drink. The main location is the fairground near the town centre, about 10 minutes by car from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Can I combine a boat rental with visiting the Feria?
faq.a: Absolutely. Most guests charter a boat during the day (e.g., 10:00–18:00) to enjoy the coast, anchor for lunch, and return to Puerto Banús in time to freshen up and head to the fairground for the evening festivities. The fair's casetas and music run late, so you get the best of both worlds.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a group going to the Feria?
faq.a: For groups up to 11 pax, the Azimut 39 (€749/2h) is a solid choice. For larger groups up to 12 pax, the Mangusta 80 (from €4,719/4h) offers space and a free jet ski. The Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) is ideal for a luxury day out with plenty of deck space.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book for Feria week?
faq.a: We recommend booking at least 4 weeks ahead, ideally as soon as your dates are confirmed. Feria San Bernabe is one of the busiest weeks in Marbella, and our fleet books up quickly. Early booking also gives you the best choice of boats and time slots.

faq.q: What is included in the rental price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21% VAT). There are no hidden costs. Just bring sunscreen and swimwear.

faq.q: Can I dock near the Feria fairground?
faq.a: No, the fairground is inland, so you cannot dock directly there. However, Puerto Banús marina is only a 10-minute taxi ride away. Many guests dock at Puerto Banús, walk to the marina exit, and take a short cab to the fair.

faq.q: What is the weather like in Marbella during early June?
faq.a: Early June in Marbella typically sees daytime highs of 28–32°C, sea temperatures around 22°C, and calm seas. It's one of the best months for boating. Bring a light jacket for the evening fair visits, as temperatures can drop to 18°C.

faq.q: Is there a minimum age or deposit required?
faq.a: The minimum age to charter a boat is 18. A refundable security deposit (amount varies by boat) is required at check-in, usually €1,000–€3,000, held on your card and released after the charter. No sailing licence is needed – our skipper handles everything.

Marbella's Feria San Bernabe is the highlight of the summer calendar – a week of music, dancing, and celebration in the heart of the town. Why Combine a Boat Rental with Feria San Bernabe?

The Feria is a land-based event, but the real magic of Marbella in June is on the water. A day charter lets you escape the crowds, anchor at a secluded cove like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, enjoy a swim in the Mediterranean, and arrive back at Puerto Banús refreshed for the fair's evening casetas. It's a classic Marbella day: sea in the morning, fair at night.

Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, just 10 minutes by taxi from the fairground. We include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks – so you can focus on relaxing.

How to Book Your Charter for Feria San Bernabe 2032

Sample Itinerary: Sea + Fair Day

  • 10:00 – Board at Puerto Banús. Welcome drink and safety briefing.

  • 15:00 – Return to Puerto Banús. Disembark.

  • 18:00–late – Enjoy casetas, music, and traditional food.

This schedule gives you a full day on the water plus the fair's best hours. You can also charter a half-day (4h) if you prefer a shorter sea trip.

Local Tips for Feria San Bernabe

The fairground is located off Avenida del Mar, near the town centre. Taxis from Puerto Banús are plentiful, but expect surge pricing during peak hours (€15–20). If you drive, parking is limited – better to use a taxi or a ride-share app. Wear comfortable shoes; the fairground is large. Try the local rebujito (sherry and lemonade) and pescaíto frito (fried fish) at the casetas. The fair is family-friendly, with dedicated children's areas and rides.
